#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int n, m, r, c, d, occ[100];
pair<int, int> p[100];

namespace MinCostMaxFlow {
    const int N = 10000, M = 20000000;
    int head[N], cnt, dis[N], fr[N], id[N], S, T, total_cost;
    struct Edge {
        int to, next, val, cost;
    } edges[M];

    void add_edge(int u, int v, int w, int c) {
        edges[cnt].cost = c;
        edges[cnt].next = head[u];
        edges[cnt].to = v;
        edges[cnt].val = w;
        head[u] = cnt++;
        edges[cnt].cost = -c;
        edges[cnt].next = head[v];
        edges[cnt].to = u;
        edges[cnt].val = 0;
        head[v] = cnt++;
    }

    std::queue<int> q;
    bool in_queue[N];

    bool spfa() {
        std::fill(dis, dis + N, 0x3f3f3f3f);
        dis[S] = 0;
        q.push(S);
        in_queue[S] = true;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int x = q.front(); q.pop();
            in_queue[x] = false;
            for (int i = head[x]; i != -1; i = edges[i].next) {
                if (edges[i].val == 0) continue;
                if (dis[edges[i].to] > dis[x] + edges[i].cost) {
                    dis[edges[i].to] = dis[x] + edges[i].cost;
                    fr[edges[i].to] = x;
                    id[edges[i].to] = i;
                    if (!in_queue[edges[i].to]) {
                        in_queue[edges[i].to] = true;
                        q.push(edges[i].to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (dis[T] == dis[N - 1]) return false;
        int x = T, min_flow = 0x3f3f3f3f;
        while (x != S) {
            min_flow = std::min(min_flow, edges[id[x]].val);
            x = fr[x];
        }
        total_cost += dis[T] * min_flow;
        x = T;
        while (x != S) {
            edges[id[x]].val -= min_flow;
            edges[id[x] ^ 1].val += min_flow;
            x = fr[x];
        }
        return true;
    }
}

using namespace MinCostMaxFlow;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d", &n, &m, &r, &c, &d);
    memset(head, -1, sizeof(head));
    S = (r + n + 1) * n + 1;
    T = (r + n + 1) * n + 2;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= r; i++) {
        scanf("%d", &x);
        occ[x]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &p[i].first, &p[i].second);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < r + n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            for (int k = 1; k <= r; k++) {
                add_edge(i * n + p[j].first, (i + 1) * n + p[j].second, 1, (2 * k - 1) * d);
                add_edge(i * n + p[j].second, (i + 1) * n + p[j].first, 1, (2 * k - 1) * d);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= r + n; i++) {
        add_edge(i * n + 1, T, 0x3f3f3f3f, i * c);
        for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
            add_edge((i - 1) * n + j, i * n + j, 0x3f3f3f3f, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add_edge(S, i, occ[i], 0);
    }
    while (spfa());
    printf("%d\n", total_cost);
    return 0;
}

        std::fill(dist, dist + N, 0x3f3f3f3f);
